description: Design variations of a sequence email (see list_sequence_email_variations). Starts designing count (1 to 4, default 3) variations of the email as saved, from prompt ("a few bolder versions", "try other layouts"). Returns them at once with status generating; they finish in the background in about a minute. In MCP Apps clients it shows them as they finish. Refused for an email written in HTML (change it with edit_sequence_emails) and for A/B test steps.

companyId.description: Company ID. If omitted, uses the currently selected company.

count.description: How many variations, 1 to 4. Defaults to 3.

emailId.description: The email's ID: get_sequence.sequence.emails[].emailId, or edit_sequence_emails.emails[].emailId.

prompt.description: What the variations should explore, up to 2,000 characters.

style.description: How far to move from the email: close keeps its style and structure; fresh tries other structures in the brand's colors and fonts; bold also gives each its own look. Defaults to fresh.

name: generate_sequence_email_variations
